darkCherry.intro: A <1>Dark Cherry</1> is a blind split, for the expenses where talking about exact numbers feels weird. Think of it as money going into a shared pot, without anyone staring at a balance.
darkCherry.noTotals: <1>No totals, no balances.</1> Whoever creates it sets the amount that settles it, but the people chipping in never see the total, what's left, or what anyone else has put in.
darkCherry.giveWhatYouCan: <1>Give what you can, when you can.</1> The creator sets a comfortable range for each payment. You just log something in that range toward the pot, once, or as many times as you like.
darkCherry.closesItself: <1>It closes itself.</1> When the pot quietly reaches the target, the cherry is settled and everyone sees it's done. Nobody ever had to ask anyone for a specific amount.
darkCherry.footer: It's for the households where "you owe me $43.50" lands wrong. A little less precise, a lot more kind.

privacy.overviewBody: Have Another Cherry is provided by Situated Strategies LLC ("we", "us"). This is a plain-language summary of our Privacy Policy: what we collect, how we use it, and the choices you have. The complete policy, including GDPR and US state privacy rights, lives at <1>{{site}}/privacy</1> and is the authoritative version. We built the app to keep your financial details private by default.
privacy.collectAccount: <1>Account information:</1> your name and email address. We save your email: it is how you sign in and how we reach you. It is the only contact information we keep. It is stored with your account, and it appears in your household's member list so the people you share with can tell each other apart.
privacy.collectProfile: <1>Financial profile:</1> your responses to the profile quiz and the income figures you enter, used to tailor split recommendations and insights.
privacy.collectLedger: <1>Expense and ledger data:</1> the expenses, settlements, and comments you log. Sensitive details are encrypted on your device before being sent to our database.
privacy.collectReceipts: <1>Receipt images</1> you choose to scan, which are processed to extract expense details.
privacy.collectVault: <1>Household Vault content</1> you ask us to organise: notes, bills, statements, photos. Unlike your ledger, this is readable during processing so a model can extract a title, amount, due date and category; the endpoint is stateless and retains nothing, and the result is encrypted on your device before it is saved. Vault entries you save without requesting AI organisation are never sent.
privacy.protectEncrypted: <1>Encrypted before storage:</1> expense details and ledgers are encrypted on your device with AES-GCM before they are sent, and our database encrypts everything at rest as well.
privacy.protectAi: <1>Content you submit for AI processing</1> (receipt scans, Vault organisation) is readable while it is processed, because a model cannot read what only your device can decrypt. Nothing else leaves your device unencrypted.
privacy.protectNotEncrypted: <1>What is not encrypted:</1> your household's member list, which holds each member's name and email so the app can show who owes what. Your ledger entries are encrypted; the list of who is in the household is not.
privacy.protectIsolation: <1>Group isolation:</1> security rules restrict data access to members of your own group.
privacy.useBody: To provide and operate the app: creating your group, splitting expenses, generating your financial profile and split recommendations, sending invite emails you request, and scanning receipts you submit. We do not sell your personal information.
privacy.emailBody: We save your email address and use it to service you: signing in, verification, password resets, invites, payment reminders a group member chooses to send, and product updates only if you opt in. We never sell it or share it beyond the providers that deliver the service. Our emails are written so they never contain your amounts, balances, or expense details, and every email includes a way to unsubscribe. Essential account emails, like a password reset you request, are the only exception.
privacy.providersBody: We rely on trusted providers to run the app, including Google Firebase (authentication and database), Google Cloud / Vertex AI (receipt scanning and profile generation), and Resend (delivering our emails; our messages are written so its delivery logs never contain your ledger details). These providers process data on our behalf under their own terms.
privacy.choicesExport: <1>Export:</1> download your ledger as a CSV at any time from Settings.
privacy.choicesLeave: <1>Leave a group:</1> remove yourself from a group while keeping your account.
privacy.choicesDelete: <1>Delete your account:</1> permanently deletes your profile, financial data, group membership, and sign-in account. This cannot be undone.
privacy.retentionBody: We keep your information for as long as your account is active. When you delete your account, your profile and personal data are removed and you are scrubbed from your group's member list.
privacy.ageBody1: Have Another Cherry is for anyone 13 and up. We built it for households, roommates, friends, and young people who are learning to manage shared money and to have honest, low-drama conversations about it. If you are between 13 and 17, use the app with a parent or guardian's permission. Inviting them into your group is a fine way to practice.
privacy.ageBody2: The app is not directed to children under 13, and we do not knowingly collect their information. If you believe a child under 13 has created an account, email {{email}} and we will delete it.
privacy.changesBody: We may update this policy from time to time. When we do, we will revise the effective date above.
privacy.contactBody: Support: <1>{{support}}</1>. Privacy questions or rights requests: <3>{{privacy}}</3>.

terms.acceptanceBody: By creating an account or using Have Another Cherry (the "Service", provided by Situated Strategies LLC), you agree to these Terms of Service. This is a plain-language summary; the complete Terms live at <1>{{site}}/terms</1> and are the authoritative version. If you do not agree, please do not use the Service.
terms.serviceBody: Have Another Cherry helps households and groups split shared expenses, track settlements, and understand their spending. Features include expense logging, income-based split recommendations, a financial-profile quiz, and AI-assisted receipt scanning.
terms.eligibilityBody: You must be at least 13 years old to use the Service. If you are under 18, you may use it only with the permission of a parent or legal guardian, who agrees to these Terms on your behalf. You are responsible for keeping your login credentials secure and for all activity under your account. Your group's invite code is what keeps your ledger private. Share it only with people you trust.
terms.notAdviceBody: Split recommendations, financial profiles, and any insights are provided for informational purposes only and are not financial, tax, or legal advice. The Service records what you and your group members enter; it does not move money. You are solely responsible for actual payments and settlements between members.
terms.aiBody: Receipt scanning and profile generation use automated AI systems and may be inaccurate or incomplete. Always review scanned amounts and details before relying on them.
terms.communicationsBody: By creating an account you agree to receive essential service emails: verification, password resets you request, invitations, and payment reminders a member of your group chooses to send. Optional product updates are sent only if you opt in. Every email includes a way to unsubscribe, and none of our emails ever contain your amounts, balances, or expense details.
terms.plansBody: The free plan is genuinely free: unlimited expenses, no ads, no daily limits. Cherry + is our optional premium tier (the Household Vault, blind splits, spending thresholds, rhythm, insights and backups), sold as a monthly or yearly subscription or a one-time lifetime purchase, on the web through RevenueCat and Stripe or in the apps through the App Store and Google Play under those stores' terms. Monthly and yearly plans start with a 14-day free trial; cancel before it ends and you pay nothing. It applies to every device you sign in on.
terms.acceptableUseBody: You agree not to misuse the Service, including attempting to access other groups' data, disrupting the Service, or using it for unlawful purposes.
terms.yourDataBody: You retain ownership of the content you enter. Our handling of your data is described in the Privacy Policy. You may export or delete your data as described there.
terms.terminationBody: You may stop using the Service and delete your account at any time. We may suspend or terminate access if these Terms are violated.
terms.disclaimersBody: The Service is provided "as is" without warranties of any kind. To the fullest extent permitted by law, we are not liable for any indirect or consequential damages, or for disputes between group members regarding shared expenses.
terms.changesBody: We may update these Terms from time to time. Continued use of the Service after changes take effect constitutes acceptance of the updated Terms.
terms.contactBody: Questions about these Terms? Contact Situated Strategies LLC at <1>{{privacy}}</1>. Support: <3>{{support}}</3>.

privacyModal.title: Data, Privacy and Security
privacyModal.intro: Here is what actually protects your ledger, described as plainly as we can manage. The full detail is in the Privacy Policy below.
privacyModal.encrypted: <1>Encrypted before it is stored:</1> Sensitive expense details are encrypted on your device with AES-GCM before they are sent to our database, and the database encrypts everything at rest as well. Your ledger is not sitting in a table anyone can read at a glance.
privacyModal.minimalContact: <1>Minimal contact data:</1> We save your email address to sign you in and send you service emails. It's the only contact information we keep, and we never sell it or share it beyond the service providers listed in our Privacy Policy. It is stored with your account so you can sign in, and it appears in your household's member list so the people you share with can tell each other apart. Our emails never contain your amounts or expense details.
privacyModal.isolation: <1>Group isolation:</1> Firestore security rules restrict every group's data to the members of that group, and we run an automated test suite against those rules so a change cannot quietly loosen them.
privacyModal.notifications: <1>Notifications say very little:</1> A notification tells you that something happened or that a bill is due tomorrow. It never carries an amount, a balance, or the name of an expense, because it passes through Apple's and Google's delivery services and lands on your lock screen.
privacyModal.noAds: <1>No ads:</1> the app shows no advertising, on the free plan or on Cherry +, and no ad network ever receives anything from it: not your ledger, not your email, not your device.
privacyModal.deleteAll: <1>You can delete all of it:</1> deleting your account removes you from your households, hands your share of each split to whoever is left, and deletes your profile and your sign-in. A household you share with other people keeps its ledger, because it is theirs too; a household where you were the last member is deleted with you.
privacyModal.quote: We made the math take care of itself, so all that's left is the conversation. And money talk, had gently and honestly, can be the start of something sweet.
privacyModal.trademarks: Google Cloud and Firebase are trademarks of Google LLC.
privacyModal.readPrivacy: Read how we handle your data.
privacyModal.deleteWarning: Permanently deletes your profile, financial data, group membership, and your sign-in account. This cannot be undone.

insights.title: Insights
insights.empty: Log a few expenses and this fills in.
insights.subtitle: How the money moved, not just how much.
insights.howPaidBody: Cash and credit are not the same event. This is the split of everything logged.
insights.frontedBody: Floating the household on a card is a real cost to one person that an even split hides.
insights.timeBody: Median, so one expense that sat for months cannot make the whole household look slow.
insights.venmoBody: An upper bound. The app cannot tell whether a payment was taken instantly or on the free standard transfer, so this is what instant would have cost.
insights.byCategoryBody: What it costs, how long it takes to come back, and who ends up carrying it.

carrying.title: Who's carrying what
carrying.body: Money out for the household that has not come back. A card balance someone is floating is a different favour from cash already gone.
carrying.nobody: Nobody is carrying anything right now. Everything fronted has come back.
carrying.unknown: How it was paid not recorded
carrying.confirmedOnly: Confirmed payments only, so it agrees with Balances.

monthAhead.title: My month ahead
monthAhead.teaser: Your share of the month, dated, before it comes due, with Cherry +.
monthAhead.empty: Nothing with your name on it in {{month}} yet. Recurring costs show up here before they come due.
monthAhead.shareSummary: Your share of the month is {{total}}: {{logged}} logged
monthAhead.plusCarried: Plus {{amount}} still open from earlier months.
monthAhead.disclaimer: Your household's own numbers, arranged by date. Not financial advice.

owed.nudgeOnWay: A gentle nudge is on its way to {{name}}.
owed.couldNotSend: Could not send the reminder. Please try again.
owed.privacyNote: Reminders arrive as a kind, no-pressure email from tartcherry@haveanothercherry.com. For privacy, the email never includes amounts or expense names: it just says an open balance is waiting in the app.

align.fallbackHigh: It looks like the numbers you each had in mind are pretty far apart. That usually just means you haven't had the full conversation yet. Maybe start with: "What does a fair split feel like to you, and what would you want me to know about your situation?"
align.fallbackMid: The income estimates don't quite line up. A gentle way in: "I think I have been guessing at your numbers. Can we compare notes so the split feels fair to everyone?"
align.fallbackLow: You're close, but not quite in sync on the numbers. Try: "Quick money check-in. Want to make sure our split still matches reality?"
align.title: Financial Alignment
align.notFinished: Hasn't finished the profile quiz yet.
align.estimateOther: Estimate of the other person's income
align.differBy: These differ by up to <1>{{pct}}%</1>. That gap is what triggered this check-in.
align.wayToStart: A Way to Start the Conversation

budget.title: Budget and Payments
budget.thresholdBody: The most you want to owe on a single shared expense. Everyone on the expense gets a heads-up when a split goes over it.
budget.howPeoplePayBody: Add your handles for the apps your group uses and members get a one-tap way into them when they settle up with you.
budget.noHandoffs: Your group has not picked any payment apps yet. The ones for your region are shown.

backup.done_one: Backed up and verified: {{count}} item in the cloud ({{size}}KB, encrypted with your group key). We read it back from Firestore to confirm.
backup.done_few: Backed up and verified: {{count}} items in the cloud ({{size}}KB, encrypted with your group key). We read it back from Firestore to confirm.
backup.done_many: Backed up and verified: {{count}} items in the cloud ({{size}}KB, encrypted with your group key). We read it back from Firestore to confirm.
backup.done_other: Backed up and verified: {{count}} items in the cloud ({{size}}KB, encrypted with your group key). We read it back from Firestore to confirm.
backup.failed: Backup failed. Check your connection and try again.
backup.enterKeyFirst: Enter or save your group key first, then restore.
backup.restoreConfirm: Restore will REPLACE your current local ledger with the cloud backup. Any local changes since the last backup will be lost. Continue?
backup.noBackup: No cloud backup found for this account yet.
backup.decryptFailed: Could not decrypt the backup. Is the group key correct?

backup.title: Backup and Recovery
backup.secretKeyBody: Your ledger is encrypted with this key before it ever leaves your device. Save it, share the exact phrase with your group, and keep it somewhere safe. It's the only way to restore a backup.
backup.noMatch: Doesn't match your group's saved key
backup.cloudBody: Back up your local ledger to the cloud, encrypted with your group key. Only someone with the key can read it. Not other members, not us.
backup.restoreNote: Restoring replaces your current ledger. You'll be asked to confirm first.

plan.extraJuicyBlurb: Great time to bring this up. The balance is in your favor.
plan.juicyBlurb: This looks reasonable to propose right now.
plan.littleJuiceBlurb: Doable, but worth a gentle, considerate conversation first.
plan.noJuiceBlurb: Maybe hold off, or plan to cover more of it yourself for now.

good.0: Hey, I've been eyeing {{item}} for us. Want to split it {{theirPct}}%/{{yourPct}}%? Your part would be about {{theirShare}}.
good.1: I think {{item}} would be a great add for the place. Fair split puts you around {{theirShare}}. How does that sit with you?
good.2: Been thinking about {{item}}. Given how things have balanced out, splitting it feels fair. You'd be at about {{theirShare}}. Thoughts?

careful.0: No pressure at all, but I've been considering {{item}} (about {{theirShare}} for your share). Is now an okay time, or should we plan for later?
careful.1: I'd love to get {{item}} eventually. Your share would be about {{theirShare}}. Want to talk through timing so it's comfortable for everyone?

hold.0: I've been wanting {{item}}, but I know things are a bit tight. No rush. Maybe we revisit it next month?
hold.1: Thinking ahead to {{item}} (about {{theirShare}} for your part). Totally fine to wait. Want to set a target date instead?

plan.title: Plan a Purchase
plan.introSolo: Thinking about a big purchase? See what it would cost you. Once someone joins, this weighs the balance between you too.
plan.intro: Thinking about a big shared purchase? See if it's a good moment to bring it up, based on your real balances.
plan.whoeverPays: Whoever pays is owed the others' shares.
plan.spreadBody: Carrying a large purchase changes what it costs each month, not what it costs.
plan.soloBody: Nobody has joined yet, so this is all yours for now. Invite someone from Settings and this turns into a split and a conversation starter.
plan.whatItDoesEach: What it does to each of you
plan.netBody: Net position today, what this adds, and where it leaves you. A negative number means you are owed.
plan.overThreshold: Your share works out at {{amount}}{{perMonth}}, past the {{threshold}} you set as comfortable. Worth talking about before it is logged.
plan.enterPriceSolo: Enter a price to see what it would cost you.
plan.enterPrice: Enter a price to see whether it's a juicy time to ask.
